blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Nards Pinto came through once again for Barangay Ginebra in a deciding game of a playoff series on Tuesday when the Gin Kings rallied to beat San Miguel Beer for a spot in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup semifinals. Pinto’s nine points and two steals in a 10-minute appearance in the 110-94 win as the Gin Kings survived the Beermen in Game 5 of their quarterfinal series at Ynares Center in Antipolo on Tuesday despite squandering a 2-0 lead and trailing by 13 in the third quarter of the decider.
